title: Life belongs more properly to God than to any creature
source_text: XI. Jam autem, si quis ex iis quae dicta sunt rite perpendat qua in re consistat vita & ejus perfectio, & creaturarum, quae vivere dicuntur, comparationem cum Deo instituat, facile agnoscet vitam magis proprie Deo competere quam ulli creaturae, & modo multo eminentiori.
pass_a_gloss: But now, if anyone from what has been said rightly weighs in what life and its perfection consist, and institutes a comparison of the creatures which are said to live with God, he will easily acknowledge that life belongs more properly to God than to any creature, and in a far more eminent way.
pass_b_english: Weigh life’s marks against the creature grades.
Life fits God more properly than any creature.
And in a far more eminent mode.

lemmas.gloss: that life belongs more properly to God
in a far more eminent way
